name: Digital Conversion – Push Notifications & Marketing Hub
author: Digital Conversion

sections.description:
Turn your WordPress site into a complete marketing hub with smart web push notifications.
Boost engagement, recover abandoned carts, increase conversions, and now leverage AI-driven insights to optimize your campaigns like never before.

🚀 Why Digital Conversion?

Unlike basic notification plugins, Digital Conversion is a full marketing automation platform built for results. We combine AI, unlimited segmentation, A/B testing, and deep analytics to help you grow.

✅ Easy Setup in Minutes
– Install plugin and create a free account
– Automatic VAPID configuration
– Works with any WordPress theme
– No coding required

🤖 AI Campaign Insights
– Automatic performance analysis
– Personalized recommendations
– Multi-language reports (EN, PT, ES, FR)
– Identify best times, devices, and audience segments

🧪 A/B Testing for Everyone
– Included in all plans (even free)
– Compare titles, messages, and CTAs
– Data-driven optimization

📊 Advanced Marketing Automation
– Behavior-based triggers
– Unlimited segmentation
– Abandoned cart recovery (WooCommerce)
– Automated or manual campaigns
– Drip sequences and workflows

📈 Powerful Analytics
– Real-time CTR and conversion tracking
– Audience insights by device, browser, OS
– Geographic and language breakdown
– Campaign benchmarks vs. site averages
– Exportable reports

🛒 E-commerce Ready
– Deep WooCommerce integration
– Product view & purchase tracking
– Cart abandonment recovery
– Conversion attribution

🎯 Unlimited Segmentation & Subscribers
– Unlimited users/subscribers included
– Segment by geography, device, language, or behavior
– Manage multiple sites with one account

🌍 Enterprise-Level Features
– Multi-site support
– Multi-language support (EN, PT, ES, FR)
– GDPR compliant
– Priority support for premium plans

Free Plan Included

Get started for free:
– 1000 push notifications per month
– 1 website
– 10 manual campaigns/month
– Unlimited automated campaigns
– Unlimited subscribers
– Unlimited segmentation
– A/B testing included
– Standard support

Upgrade anytime for unlimited websites, more campaigns, and premium features.
sections.installation:
1. Install plugin via WordPress admin or WordPress.org
  2. Create a free account in settings
  3. API key is automatically configured
  4. Customize your opt-in modal and notifications
  5. Start sending your first campaign 🚀
sections.faq:
Do you offer AI features?

Yes! Our AI engine analyzes your campaigns and gives clear insights and optimization tips.

Is A/B testing really included in all plans?

Correct! Even free users can run A/B tests to optimize engagement.

Is it free to start?

Yes. Free plan includes 1000 push/month, unlimited subscribers, unlimited segmentation, and A/B testing.

Does it support WooCommerce?

Yes. Full WooCommerce integration for cart recovery, product view tracking, and conversion attribution.

Can I use it for multiple sites?

Yes, premium plans include multi-site support. Agencies love it.
